title: Aphelios Elderwood
tips: Comp to play with AD items and an elderwood emblem. If you hit elderwood lux with emblem you can drop Lillia for 9 Elderwood.

stages.text: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll for Aphelios and Ezreal, you should be stable with 7 elderwood and one of these 2 starred. Go 9 when stable for Gnar+Lux.

title: Brambleback Riftbeast
tips: Alpha Mark the Brambleback. Position him on the weak side of the enemy so you can get jump resets quickly. 3* Riftbeasts are generally bait except for frontline.

stages.text: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Brambleback items. Murkwolf can hold items.
Aim to get 7 Riftbeast online latest by Stage 3-5. Use free Riftbeast shops to upgrade only instead of rerolling. Finish Bramble / tank items.
Level to 8 and look for Bramble + Brawler or Rakan. Always play Elder Dragon when you hit. Once stable, go 9 for another 5 cost.

title: Alune Vanguard
tips: Cap the board with a Lux over Morgana for end game. Lunar Lux is best but play whatever Lux you are likely to 2* first. Carry / tank 4 cost units until you get to the end game. Always focus on unit quality over exact board units.

stages.text: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with AP items. Ideal opener will be Blossom featuring Karma / Spellweavers.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

title: Teemo Sprykin
tips: Best with winstreak opener around Leblanc or Teemo with Brawler frontline. Teemo likes crit items but slam any strong AP items to get the streak going. Morgana holds utility items late game.

stages.text: Open with a win streak Teemo start and itemize him ASAP. The more Teemo casts, the more likely you can collect value off his mushrooms.
Level to 6 and roll for your 2* upgrades to stabilize and win streak Stage 3. Econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Finish Teemo 3* and your tank then push levels for more Invokers. If you get more damage items late game Morgana can hold the utility.

title: Sentinel Vanguard
tips: Average placement 4.30 across 27,442 games. Level 9 is the most common finish (62%). Best Sentinel build: Gargoyle Stoneplate, Protector's Vow, Warmog's Armor.
tipsVi: Hạng trung bình 4.30 qua 27.442 trận. Cấp 9 là mức kết thúc phổ biến nhất (62%). Trang bị tốt nhất cho Sentinel: Gargoyle Stoneplate, Protector's Vow, Warmog's Armor.

title: Veigar Blackthorn
tips: Ideally played with a strong condition such as good Artifact, emblem, or many copies of Veigar / Ornn. Sacrifice Lifebloom plant to Blackthorn early. Late game you can sacrifice Leblanc 3 for big stats -> move her items to another spellweaver. After you cash out first Ornn artifact, move items to Alistar.

stages.text: Only play around this opener with early upgrades so Veigar can snowball and gain stacks. Prioritize Veigar items.
If you are close to Veigar and Ornn 3 (7+ copies), consider rolling until you hit 3*. If far (3-4 copies), slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Once you finish Ornn 3 and Veigar 3, you can slowroll on 6 for Leblanc + Alistar 3, if you are too far push levels..

title: Azir Blackthorn
tips: This comp requires lots of rods so take item augments early. Blackthorn sacrifice hex scales off gold value: 3* Teemo > 2* AP 4 cost that isn't holding items > 2* Teemo > 2* Veigar. Blackthorn Lux is a very strong win condition worth playing.

stages.text: Try to angle this comp with early Azir ideally with Blossom opener for better charms. Take rods off carousel whenever possible.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Make sure you have 2* Azir, Rammus 4-1, then slowroll above 50 for 3 stars. Once you finish, level for more Summoner / Executioner.

title: Ahri & Morgana Blossom
tips: Morgana holds utility items. You can tank either Sentinel or Sett. Best emblem = Invoker on Ahri. Late game cap with Ashe + Alune over Karma.

stages.text: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Blossom or Spellweavers as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Morgana, and the frontline. Once stable, go level 9 for Lux.

title: Karma & Yunara Blossom
tips: Prioritize 3* Karma + 3 Blossom + LeBlanc early for clone copies. Add 3 Solar after you finish your 3* (Leona / Kayle not necessary).

stages.text: Slam items for Karma and play for win streak with Blossom in. Tank Yorick / Juggernaut until you find Sejuani 2.
Try to look for an econ/exp wisp every round when rolling. Prioritize Karma 3 > Sejuani 3 > Yorick 3 > Leblanc / Yunara 3. Leona / Kayle not necessary.
Finish your 3* then level for 3 Solar over time. Leftover AP items on LeBlanc. Karma 3 can also hold items too.

title: Master Yi Adaptor
tips: +1 tier in strength with Artifact.  VI 3 is stronger than Krug 3. Item priority: Master Yi/Rengar > Tank > Nidalee. Only take Phoenix Primal buff if ahead. Otherwise, Execute / Healing Primal. Rengar and Yi have the exact same BIS. Yi is stronger but itemize whoever is upgraded first.

stages.text: Ideally play around a Rengar opener that can win streak. Blossom is very powerful to get early econ or item wisps.
Add more Adaptors and frontline as you go. Finish Yi/Rengar items by end of stage. You can even play 5 Blossom for maximum Wisp greed if you highroll the 4 costs.
Level to 7 and roll for Master Yi 2, Rengar 2, and a Juggernaut Tank. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. Add Kog or a flex unit in at 8.

title: Draven & Ezreal Elderwood
tips: Only play from early win streak and lots of gold. Because you are aiming for scaling 5 costs, aim to level 9 around end of Stage 4 / beginning of Stage 5. Best Draven quests are dealing damage for gold, but avoid the 10k damage in 1 round because you can get trapped.

stages.text: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Draven items. Ideal opener will be some kind of resource engine like Rengar or Blossom.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 end of Stage 4 and look for the scaling 5 costs like Draven, Maokai, and Ivern.

title: Warwick Ravager
tips: Aim to play a 3* unit in the Blackthorn center hex for max stats, preferably Krug 3. Leftover AD items on Murkwolf. Can also tank Rek'sai 3 if you can't find Malphite 2.

stages.text: If you don't have Shojin, consider lose streak to guarantee it on carousel. If you have Shojin + good component, play for win streak instead.
Level to 6 and roll for Warwick 2 with 4 Blackthorn + 2 Ravager. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. You can also play 4 Ravager temporarily if needed.
Finish Warwick 3 and push levels. If you don't have Murkwolf 3, look for Brambleback as your duo carry.

title: Draven Legendaries
tips: Alpha Mark the Elder Dragon. Your duo carry with Elder Dragon is ideally Draven but its highly flexible. Can replace for Lux, Alune, Soraka for AP options.

stages.text: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Riftbeast items. Ideal opener will be Riftbeasts featuring Cinderling / Gromp / Mama Beak carry.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

title: Mama Beak Vanguard
tips: Alpha Mark Mama Beak. Tank is flexible but ideally its Hecarim 3 > Krug 3 > Alistar 3. Radiant Rageblade is true BIS Mama Beak.

stages.text: Play strongest board around upgraded Rapidfire and Elderwood. Can also play Inferno to get upgraded shop slots.
Focus on econ and finishing your items. If rich, you can level at 3-5 and roll for upgrades for the rest of the stage. Otherwise, go to 7 at 4-1.
Roll until you upgrade Mama Beak 2 and your main tank. Then econ up and slow roll for 3*. Add 3 summoner or 5 cost on 8.

title: Aphelios Lunar
tips: Position Nidalee on weak side to get a quick kill then jump backline. Amumu or Sentinel 2 can be your main tank (you're often contested so prioritize whichever gets upgraded). Kogmaw Provides Free Shred + Sunder.

stages.text: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

title: Ezreal Elderwood
tips: Mainly strong with Elderwood emblem. Look for Elderwood Lux. 3 Executioner is a big spike so always look to play around it if possible. Can also chase 9 Elderwood if you have Elderwood Lux.

stages.text: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Add more Elderwood as you level with Spellweavers. If you start getting AD items, play them on Xayah / Rapidfires.
Level to 8 and look for Ezreal and Soraka with 7 Elderwood. Try not to roll to 0g because we need gold to get to level 9.

title: Ezreal Executioner
tips: Best with Executioner emblem. Focus Ezreal + Tank items first then rest on Ahri->Soraka. Elderwood Lux caps the board.

stages.text: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Add more Elderwood as you level with Spellweavers. If you start getting AD items, play them on Xayah / Rapidfires.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Ezreal and the 4 costs, only go 9 once you have upgraded most things.

title: Sivir Hunter
tips: Kog'maw and Inferno provide utility so you can focus on building pure offense / tank items. Choose Execute Primal ideally. Ashe with utility items caps the final board. With Fae Emblem, add in Tristana over Kogmaw.

stages.text: Play from a strong AD opener and slam all your items. When in doubt, take sword off carousel since this composition can use 6+ easily.
Add in more Hunters and frontline as necessary. You can transition to Sivir 1 as the carry if you high roll her early.
Level to 8 and roll down for Sivir and upgraded frontline. Early Ashe can go in over Kog'maw if you have Last Whisper. Go 9 once stable.

title: Ashe Juggernaut
tips: Consider this as a flex option for a Sivir board if you were playing around Juggernauts in the midgame already. If you get Juggernaut emblem, you can play 6 Juggernauts. Can also play other 5 cost AD carries like Dragon and Draven. Take turtle primal buff.

stages.text: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara. Slam generic AD items and Tank items for a win streak.
Level up for more juggernauts and executioners to pair with our blossom opener.
Level and roll for 6 juggernauts +Sivir. Once stable, go 9 and look for Ashe and transition your board to 5 costs.

title: Tristana Fae
tips: Only play when you have Fae emblem. Stacking 4 Fae ASAP is important so you can get a gold engine. Can also tank Vi primary if you can't find Rammus. Execute Primal > Item Primal unless very far ahead / win streaking.

stages.text: Play for win streak with upgraded Rageblade holder. Start stacking Fae since getting to 7 ASAP is crucial for success.
Itemize and play Tristana as soon as you find her. Sprykin is more important than Hunter. If you spike very early Primal from ahead, you can consider items.
Level to 7 and roll above 50g for 3* Tristana and Rammus. Use your 4 Fae cash outs to push levels. Give Sivir leftover AD items.

title: Zyra Juggernaut
tips: Turtle Primal buff. Composition is flexible as long as you get to the upgraded Juggernaut frontline. Best with Juggernaut emblem on Kennen. Prio Zyra Items > secondary carries. Sivir + Ashe is strong, but AP Nidalee or 5 costs like Ivern/Lux/Draven are also good.

stages.text: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Tank items for a win streak.
Ideally start holding more juggernauts to pair with the Yorick blossom opener, consider moving karma items to LB or Cassio 2.
Level and roll for 6 Juggernauts + Zyra and a duo-carry. You can push 9 when you hit Zyra 2. Tank Vi 2 over Amumu 1. End game move items to Maokai.

title: Camille & Akali Solar
tips: Akali can be AD or AP (Flex IE/JG) Itemize Tank + 3star melee first -> 2nd melee -> Varus items. Only go for Kayle and Sej 3 with lots of money. Can  Swap out Ornn for Yorick/Rakan.

stages.text: Look to play with lots of early copies of 1 cost + good reroll augment.
Roll to 30 on 3-1 level 4 for extra 1 cost copies. Then slow roll on 5 until you have 5 3 stars for solar bonus.
Make sure you keep your econ high because you need to be level 7 to fit solar on this board. Try to be Level to 7 somewhere on stage 4.

title: Ahri & Zyra Blossom
tips: +1 tier in strength with Bronze For Life augment. If playing from ahead on winstreak, consider playing 5 Blossom on level 8 with Karma, then rush 9 for the 5 costs -> Alune 2 carry late game.

stages.text: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Spellweavers + frontline as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Zyra, and the 4 Spellweavers. Play Cassio or LeBlanc until you find Alune. Can flex in Infernos over Lillia if needed.

title: Caitlyn Juggernaut
tips: Can also tank Sejuani 3. Tank whoever you can hit first. Can also play 4 Vanguard version with Elise. Sivir takes leftover utility / AD items (red buff highly impractical so oftentimes you play Morello). Take Turtle Primal buff. +1 or 2 tiers with radiant items (especially radiant Guinsoo).

stages.text: Slam Rageblade and bow items on Caitlyn for a winstreak. BIS Caitlyn is often hard to get so you can also slam items like Gunblade or Giant Slayer.
Level to 6 and roll for 4 Juggernaut + 2 Hunter. Ideally upgrade Caitlyn 2 and 2 cost Juggernaut then econ up -> slow roll above 50g for 3* units.
Finish your 3* ideally by mid Stage 4. Level for more Hunters. Take Turtle Primal unless you are super high rolling and can take items.

title: Karma & Yunara Blackthorn
tips: Play when you have lots of copies of Yunara with Blackthorn emblem. Prioritize Yunara > Tank > Warwick items. Murkwolf can also hold items temporarily until you get Yunara online. End game put Last Whisper on Ezreal and give Yunara a 3rd true damage item.

stages.text: Slam items for Yunara and play for win streak with Blossom in. Tank Yorick / Juggernaut until you find Alistar.
Level at 3-2 and roll for 2* upgrades then econ up. Skip Azir 2 because he's too expensive. Buy a charm every round if possible and win streak.
Finish your 3* units then push levels. Look for 3 Executioner for Yunara. Kennen caps your board. Blackthorn Lux is a high roll top end finisher.

title: Cassiopeia Defender
tips: Very BIS dependent. Can play from Coven Cashout. Can also play for Ornn 3 to potentially farm Artifacts. Always play 6 Defender. Duo carry on 8 is any 4 or 5 cost AP carry. Titans on fiddle because we have no other use for bow.

stages.text: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Invokers. Karma is an example shown but you can also play Invokers or Coven lose streak.
If lose streaking with Coven, try to kill some units each fight to preserve HP. If win streaking, push standard winstreak tempo (6 @ 3-2, 7 @ 3-5) and save econ.
Cash out / roll on level 7 for Cassio 2 / Fiddle 2. Then econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3* units. Then level to 8 for a duo carry.

title: Aphelios Rapidfire
tips: Only strong with +1 Rapidfire, play another version if you have it. Don't need much attack speed with 5 rapidfire.

stages.text: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. All ad items are good slams besides rageblade.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

title: Aphelios Vanguard
tips: Core units are Aphelios + Diana + Sentinel + Mama Beak. Red Buff is BIS Aphelios but you can also play Rageblade build. Play Scuttlecrab + Rakan over Brambleback if no melee items. Can duo carry Zyra or Morgana if extra AP items.

stages.text: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

title: Varus & Kayle Solar
tips: Roll on 3-1 to try and finish a 3* 1 cost for bench space -> Slow roll above 50g on level 5. Ornn Artifact print is very strong but only scales quickly once you get him to 3*. Kayle has built in 20% Shred at 2*.

stages.text: Ideally open with Kayle and upgraded Ornn. After Rageblade, prioritize tank items on Ornn so he can begin reliably stacking Artifact scaling.
Bench priority: Kayle 3 > Ornn 3 > Xayah / Leona > Sejuani > Rakan. Once you finish 1 costs, move up to level 6 for 2 costs.
Finish your 3* and level for Elderwood. Cap with any 5 costs like Lux, Ivern, Taric, etc.

title: Kha'Zix Elderwood
tips: If you have HOJ first, go Executioner > Ravager. If you have AP / Mana / tempo slams, go Ravager > Executioner. Then pick Spellweaver > Rapidfire with the last evolutions. Can play 3rd Executioner/Lux/Ivern as max cap.

stages.text: Slam items aggressively on Kha'zix and move them later. It's okay to have Spark, Shojin, etc on Khazix early for takedowns.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Slow roll on 7 for 3* upgrades on whatever 3 costs you're chasing. In this example, give leftover AP items to Diana.

title: Veigar Sprykin
tips: Best with Artifact / special items. Very strong with Dawncore, Consuming Flora, and Ludens as well. Sacrifice a 3* unit for maximum Blackthorn stats.

stages.text: Only play around this opener with early upgrades so Veigar can snowball and gain stacks. Prioritize Veigar items.
If you are close to Veigar 3 (7+ copies), consider rolling until you hit 3*. If far (3-4 copies), slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Once you finish your 3*, push levels for more Spyrkin, Blackthorn, or Brawlers.

title: Aphelios Inferno
tips: Frontline is very flexible: Lillia + Amumu + Sentinel are your flex options. Best with Lunar emblem so you can avoid the Alune lottery. When in doubt, add frontline to stall for Eclipse. Lux caps the board.

stages.text: Play any tempo opener that can lead to Aphelios. Standard board is AD + upgraded frontline. Take the spatula off carousel for Lunar if possible.
Hold copies of Solar on your bench. If you upgrade them, play the Solar units as frontline. Kayle is quite weak so don't carry unless necessary.
Level to 8 and look for any frontline that can stall for Eclipse. Lillia 2 is the easiest to hit, but you can also tank Amumu, Sentinel, etc.

title: Elise Coven
tips: Play with Dark Ritual augment to convert cash out -> AP. Ideally ply for a 250+ cashout for AP first, then take 40s if you need for more stacking. 2x Morgana 2* with items on both is the best way to cap your board.

stages.text: Ideally open with Coven and start gathering Essence. It is actually better to win early than lose for stacks so don't overly force lose streak.
Level to 6 and roll for a Elise 2, Covens, and Vanguards. Give Cassio or Diana leftover AP. Cash out Coven and convert to AP with at least 2-3 lives (25-30 hp).
Finish Elise 3 / Cassio 3 then level for more Vanguards or Lunar. Play 2 Morganas with items if you have extra.

title: Elise Ravager-Emblem
tips: The nerfs to Dark Ritual in Patch 18.4 have made this comp weaker than it was before. The comp is more conditional now - aim to play if you have good components / can play good losses or need direction. Prioritize taking Cassiopeia on first carousel regardless of the component most of the time - It's more important to make sure you get 4 Coven as early as possible than perfect items. Two ways to play this comp: Reroll or Fast 8. Reroll version of comp should roll on level 6 and 7 and go for Elise 3 + ideally Cassio 3. For Fast 8, hold extra copies of Cassio on Level 8 and try to 3 star her while playing 6 Vanguard or 4 Vanguard + Legendaries. When playing reroll, itemize Elise 3 as she can go infinite with the AP from augment. When pushing levels, play around Elise 2 as your tank until you 2-star Sentinel or Taric, then switch tanks. Previously Fast 8 was more common, but now reroll is looking more common. Aim for 250 cashout if possible. Prior to patch 18.4, there was a strategy to cashout 130 twice so you could win rounds in Stage 3, but post-nerf this strategy is weaker than it was before. The reason for Titan's Resolve on Elise in the reroll version is because with the AP from Dark Ritual, she often is unkillable as she heals back up with each auto attack. Often the only way for her to die is crowd control ("CC") or her walking up toward the end of a fight. Rageblade is a good item on Elise 3, but not necessary. Two tank items + Titan's or even 3 tank items are fine builds too, but it becomes more important to have good Cassio / Morgana items in these cases. For positioning Elise 3, try to avoid solo frontline in Stage 5 onward. In an ideal world, she doesn't take all aggro because it is possible for opponents to burst her down late game. The goal is split aggro enough that she drain tanks and sustains, but not so much that she dies. Do not pass by Coven Lux if you hit her. She is a massive spike - her passive and ability help all your Coven units, plus she does a ton of damage with the AP from augment.

stages.text: Level to 4 if you have upgrades and a good item to place on one of those upgrades. Level to 5, unless on 3 loss streak.

Level to 6. Roll until stable. "Stable" changes depending on rank, items, augments, composition, and patch, but generally it involves 2-starring your desired 2-cost carry and a tank with items. Major divergence between elos: The lower your elo, the less upgrades you need to be "stable" and thus lower elo players should generally roll less than high elo players on 3-2. After your 3-2 rolldown, you should attempt to rebuild your economy to 50g. Once you reach 50g (it might be later than 3-5), start slow rolling down to ~52g each turn. Try to avoid rolling to exactly 50g as any unit you want to buy in shop will put you below 50g.

If you are high HP relative to the lobby, continue slow rolling to 52g each turn. If you are lower HP, you should roll to hit your first 2-cost 3 star on 4-1 or 4-2. If you have to roll below 30g, your placement is usually capped at 3rd or 4th. If you are still high HP (70+), you can continue to slow roll. Otherwise, in the majority of cases, you should roll deep for your 3-stars here. If your HP is low, you can even go to 0 gold looking for your 3-stars. If you have your 3-stars and can afford to level to 7 with 10g+, do so.
